mission.title: Weapons of Terror
mission.description: Recover one of the imposters' black box devices.

npc.say: Get me that statue, then we'll talk about that precious black box of yours.
I already gave you the key. I got nothin' else to give. You need to just leave me alone.
Thanks! Enjoy the statue! Come again! Oh... err, no, no need to come again. Uh, we'll call you!
Well, took ya long enough. Got the statue? If so, give it to Stephan Runnels over there.
He's waiting for you. Go right in.

phase.briefing: Surveillance reports indicate that the imposters have been using "black box" devices to assist in their sabotage operations. You will recover one of these portable devices for analysis.

enter.say: Reliable reports indicate that the renegades may have left one of their black box devices in that building. Investigate.

talk.say: A black box, you say? Er, well yeah, I seen it. Actually, I sold it to a bunch of Exiles who happened by. They seemed to be in the market for mysterious devices. A lucrative coincidence for both parties involved, you might say.
This human appears to have disposed of the box carelessly. Interrogate him further--perhaps he can provide a clue as to its whereabouts.

objective.text: Get the map disk from Ismael Rutkowski

done.say: Well... I might know where you could find those Exiles. But what's in it for me? Hm. Tell you what--take this map disk. Some boys at that location have a certain statue of mine that I want back--let's just say that I'm a collector of fine merchandise. Bring me that statue and we'll talk some more about the black box. Your controller will know how to reach me.
I recommend that you deal with this... individual. If you try to obtain the box's location by force, he might give you false information. Upload that map disk to us at a hardline.

objective.text: Upload the map disk at a hardline

phase.briefing: I am uploading the new map data to your waypoint now. If that human's information was legitimate, you should find a certain "statue" at that location.

enter.say: That is the building indicated by the human's map data. Obtain the statue and leave the area with it.

talk.say: Hey hey, I'm just the janitor. I don't know nothin' about it.

objective.text: Get the master key from Reinaldo Miller

done.say: Okay, alright, hands off the threads. I'm just trying to make a living here. Anyway fine, here's the master key. I don't get paid enough to take a bullet for the company.
The door past those guards is locked. Perhaps someone in the area could be... persuaded to help you obtain entry.
That locked safe is a likely spot in which to find the statue. Perhaps one of those humans there could be of some... assistance.

talk.say: Okay, okay! Take it easy, I thought you was someone else. The statue? Oh sure, sure, we got that in our safe. H-here, I'll open it for you.

done.say: That human has unlocked the safe. The statue should be inside.
T-there you is! Just take the statue outta the safe--my compliments!

objective.text: Get the statue from the safe

done.say: That seems to be the statue that Ismael Rutkowski wants. Get out of there and I'll give you a waypoint to his current location.

phase.briefing: Your display interface has been updated with Ismael Rutkowski's location. Take the statue to him.

enter.say: Ismael Rutkowski should be in that building. Give him the statue and then get the whereabouts of the Exile gang he sold the black box to.

talk.say: Well, took ya long enough. Got the statue? If so, give it to Stephan Runnels over there.

objective.text: Give the statue to Stephan Runnels

done.say: If this human holds true to his bargain, he should now provide you with the location of the Exile gang to whom he sold the black box.

objective.text: Get the map from Ismael Rutkowski

done.say: Well now, I can see that you know how to do business like a true professional. Here's a map with the location of the Exile gang you were interested in. Take it--you've earned it.
Good. Upload that map data to us at a hardline.
Pleasure doin' business with ya! Remember ta look up ol' Ismael Rutkowski if ya ever need any exotic goods or other choice rarities.

objective.text: Upload the map at a hardline

phase.briefing: I am updating your waypoint with the location of the Exile gang as provided by Ismael Rutkowski. Go there now.

enter.say: According to Ismael Rutkowski's data, the Exiles to whom he sold the black box should be in that building. Obtain the black box from them. You need not be... gentle.

objective.text: Get the black box from the Lupine Scrapper

done.say: Ah, finally. Please upload the device at a nearby hardline.

objective.text: Upload the black box at a hardline

done.say: Our routers are receiving the device data now...

mission.finish: The activity that humans refer to as "business" is something of an enigma to us. However, you seem to have handled it nicely. Our thanks. Analysis of that black box should provide useful information.
